title: "Easy" limits by plugging in or factoring

cues.en: A few videos ago, I showed plots of different functions to illustrate the geometric concept of limits.
cues.zh: 前幾支影片，我展示了不同函數的圖，說明極限的幾何概念。

cues.en: And as you probably guessed from those examples, some limits are really easy to compute.
cues.zh: 從那些例子，你大概也猜到了，有些極限真的很容易算。

cues.en: Some limits are sort of kind of easy to compute when you know a couple of tricks.
cues.zh: 有些極限只要知道幾個技巧，也算容易。

cues.en: And there are also some limits that are really challenging to compute.
cues.zh: 還有些極限真的很難算。

cues.en: In this video, I'm going to show you two methods for computing limits of relatively easy problems.
cues.zh: 這支影片，我要示範兩種方法，計算相對簡單的極限題目。

cues.en: Actually, you know, lots of limits are trivially easy to compute.
cues.zh: 其實很多極限都簡單得不得了。

cues.en: Most of them, in fact, just not the ones that you encounter on homework problems and exam questions.
cues.zh: 事實上大多數都是，只是通常不是你在作業和考試裡遇到的那些。

cues.en: So when you first see a limit problem, the first thing to try is simply to plug in the value.
cues.zh: 所以第一次看到極限題目，首先要試的就是直接代入數值。

cues.en: So here's an example.
cues.zh: 這裡有個例子。

cues.en: In this case, we can simply plug in the value of two and find that the function value equals zero at x equals two.
cues.zh: 在這裡，我們可以直接代入 2，發現 x 等於 2 時，函數值等於 0。

cues.en: Now, keep in mind that limits are not about the function value at exactly this point.
cues.zh: 但請記得，極限談的不是恰好在這個點的函數值。

cues.en: So this isn't really about just evaluating the function at exactly x equals to Instead, limits are
cues.zh: 所以這其實不只是計算 x 恰好等於 2 時的函數值。極限談的是，

cues.en: about the value of the function as x gets closer and closer and closer and closer and closer to this value, which is two in this example.
cues.zh: 當 x 越來越接近這個值，在這個例子裡就是 2 時，函數的值。

cues.en: So whenever you plug in for a value of X, you have to inspect the function carefully to determine whether
cues.zh: 所以每當代入某個 x 值，你都必須仔細檢查函數，判斷

cues.en: a tiny change in X would give a correspondingly tiny change in the function, or whether the limit would just be something completely different.
cues.zh: x 的微小變化，是否會讓函數產生對應的微小變化，還是極限會完全不同。

cues.en: Now that sort of thing can happen with piecewise functions, and I'll say more about that in the next video.
cues.zh: 分段函數就可能出現這種情況，下一支影片我會再說明。

cues.en: So here we can see a graph of this function and it certainly looks smooth and continuous everywhere, especially around here, which is the limit as X goes to two.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到函數的圖，確實看起來處處平滑連續，尤其是在這附近，也就是 x 趨近 2 的地方。

cues.en: So we see from the definition of this function and also from the graph that there are no holes or infinite
cues.zh: 所以從函數的定義和圖形來看，在 x 等於 2 或附近，沒有孔洞、無窮

cues.en: discontinuities or weird things that are likely to happen around x equals to or at x equals to.
cues.zh: 不連續，或其他可能發生的奇怪事情。

cues.en: But looks can be deceiving.
cues.zh: 但外觀可能會騙人。

cues.en: So when plugging in a number to compute the limit, you really need to look at the equation carefully.
cues.zh: 所以代入數字計算極限時，真的要仔細看方程式。

cues.en: The visualization here is great and it's very informative, but a quick glance doesn't necessarily reveal everything.
cues.zh: 這裡的視覺化很棒，也提供很多資訊，但匆匆一瞥，不一定看得出所有事情。

cues.en: Consider this example.
cues.zh: 看看這個例子。

cues.en: Plugging in x equals two gives something divided by zero and in fact the numerator is also zero.
cues.zh: 代入 x 等於 2，會得到某個式子除以零，而且分子其實也是零。

cues.en: So this is zero over zero when we simply plug in the value of two.
cues.zh: 所以單純代入 2，就會得到零除以零。

cues.en: So just plugging in is not going to work for this kind of problem.
cues.zh: 這類題目，光靠代入就行不通。

cues.en: But notice that in this equation when X approaches two but is not exactly equal to two, then the denominator
cues.zh: 但注意，在這個方程式裡，當 x 趨近 2，卻不恰好等於 2 時，分母

cues.en: is also not exactly equal to zero.
cues.zh: 也不會恰好等於零。

cues.en: It's a tiny number, but it's not actually zero.
cues.zh: 它是個很小的數字，但不是真的零。

cues.en: Now, you might think that this equation blows up to infinity as X approaches to because this the denominator here is going to be really, really tiny.
cues.zh: 你可能以為，x 趨近 2 時，這個式子會發散到無窮大，因為這裡的分母會非常非常小。

cues.en: But wait a minute.
cues.zh: 但等一下。

cues.en: Let's think about what's happening at the numerator.
cues.zh: 想想分子會發生什麼事。

cues.en: And well, let's start by thinking about what happens when X is a little, little tiny bit bigger than two.
cues.zh: 先想想 x 比 2 稍微大一點點時會如何。

cues.en: So the denominator is a tiny number and it's positive.
cues.zh: 分母是個很小的正數。

cues.en: It's a very, very small positive number.
cues.zh: 是個非常非常小的正數。

cues.en: And the numerator also ends up being a very, very tiny number, also a positive number.
cues.zh: 分子最後也是個非常非常小的正數。

cues.en: And that's because a little tiny bit bigger than two squared is going to be a little bit bigger than four.
cues.zh: 因為比 2 大一點點的數字，平方後會比 4 大一點。

cues.en: This term here will be a little bit bigger than six.
cues.zh: 這一項會比 6 大一點。

cues.en: And so this will be a little bit bigger than ten.
cues.zh: 所以這裡會比 10 大一點。

cues.en: So basically, we have a tiny positive number divided by a tiny positive number.
cues.zh: 基本上，我們得到一個很小的正數，除以另一個很小的正數。

cues.en: So it doesn't necessarily blow up to infinity.
cues.zh: 所以不一定會發散到無窮大。

cues.en: But.
cues.zh: 不過，

cues.en: Okay, so what do we have here?
cues.zh: 好，那這裡到底是什麼？

cues.en: Well, the trick is to try some algebraic manipulations of this expression to try to cancel or at least
cues.zh: 技巧就是，試著對這個式子做一些代數運算，設法消去，或至少

cues.en: modify the denominator so that it no longer equals zero when x equals two.
cues.zh: 改變分母，讓它在 x 等於 2 時，不再等於零。

cues.en: So that's the trick.
cues.zh: 這就是技巧。

cues.en: Try to factor the numerator.
cues.zh: 試著把分子因式分解。

cues.en: Now, sometimes that kind of manipulation is easy and other times it's not.
cues.zh: 有時這種操作很簡單，有時並不簡單。

cues.en: In this case, it turns out that the numerator actually is factor bull.
cues.zh: 在這個例子裡，分子其實可以因式分解。

cues.en: You can represent this numerator as the product of x plus five and x minus two.
cues.zh: 可以把它寫成 x 加 5，乘以 x 減 2。

cues.en: And here is the trick.
cues.zh: 技巧就在這裡。

cues.en: Here's the key here.
cues.zh: 這就是關鍵。

cues.en: So this x minus two in the denominator and x minus two in the numerator will cancel.
cues.zh: 分母的 x 減 2，和分子的 x 減 2，會約掉。

cues.en: And that leaves us with the limit as x goes to two of x plus five, which is well, this is not tricky at all.
cues.zh: 剩下 x 趨近 2 時，x 加 5 的極限。這就一點也不難了。

cues.en: Now we can just plug in the value of two.
cues.zh: 現在直接代入 2 就好。

cues.en: We can look at this equation and determine.
cues.zh: 看著這個方程式，我們就能判斷，

cues.en: Nothing funny is happening at x equals two like it is in this original equation.
cues.zh: x 等於 2 時，不會出現原本方程式裡那些奇怪的事情。

cues.en: So basically we've just applied some algebraic manipulations, in particular factoring, and we've simplified
cues.zh: 基本上，我們只是做了一些代數運算，特別是因式分解，簡化了

cues.en: the expression and that allowed us to compute the limit in this kind of trivial way of just plugging in the number.
cues.zh: 式子，於是可以用直接代入數字這種簡單的方法，計算極限。

cues.en: Now you need to be careful with the interpretation here.
cues.zh: 不過解讀時要小心。

cues.en: This function is undefined at x equals two, there is no doubt about that.
cues.zh: 這個函數在 x 等於 2 時沒有定義，這一點毫無疑問。

cues.en: But as the function approaches to so when it gets really, really close to two but is not exactly equal
cues.zh: 但當它趨近 2，也就是非常非常接近 2，卻不恰好等於

cues.en: to two, the function value approaches seven and that we determined by factoring.
cues.zh: 2 時，函數值會趨近 7。這是我們透過因式分解得知的。

cues.en: So what does this mean?
cues.zh: 那這代表什麼？

cues.zh: 想想 x 趨近負無窮大和正無窮大時，會怎麼樣。

cues.en: Well, as X gets huge then, well we can just ignore these constant terms for one thing.
cues.zh: 當 x 變得很大，首先就可以忽略這些常數項。

cues.en: These kinds of terms are meaningless when X equals 100 billion.
cues.zh: 當 x 等於一千億時，這種項就沒有什麼意義。

cues.en: Similarly, X squared gets so much bigger than x as x gets much, much larger.
cues.zh: 同樣地，當 x 變得非常大，x 平方會比 x 大得多。

cues.en: X squared grows so much faster than x that we can also basically ignore this three X term over here.
cues.zh: x 平方成長得比 x 快得多，所以基本上也可以忽略這裡的 3x 項。

cues.en: Now, it's not to say it's unimportant.

cues.en: long run behavior and the long run behavior of a polynomial is basically just driven by the term with
cues.zh: 長期行為，而多項式的長期行為，基本上只由
